experiment: P4d frozen heterogeneous route two-data-seed confirmation
research_question: Does the P4c heterogeneous route retain its full-12-parameter gain on two entirely new identity pools when checkpoints, normalizers, and classification thresholds are frozen?
single_changed_axis_vs_p4c: replace the data generator seed; no training, checkpoint selection, normalizer fitting, calibration, or threshold tuning is permitted

source_freeze.classification_thresholds: frozen separately for every P4c checkpoint

data.test_generation: train-named container only; no project test split generated

evaluation.paired_unit: same frozen model seed and same external data seed

sawfm_watch_rule: Even if the numerical promotion gate passes, SawFM sweep-period worsening in 3 of 3 model seeds on both new data seeds is treated as replicated local negative transfer and triggers a new fresh-identity safe-fallback experiment before final promotion.
stop_rule: Do not tune or choose checkpoints using either external pool. On failure, freeze both pools for attribution only and preregister exactly one new mechanism on entirely new identities.
next_if_pass: Retain the heterogeneous route as the parameter backbone candidate, add strict MAC matching, then proceed to five-seed statistics and multi-axis stress tests.
